chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, by his chain, raising it, said:

Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) was asked, 'What is the limit of defecation?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not face the Qiblah, nor have your back to it, nor face the wind, nor have your back to it.' And it is reported in another Hadith: 'Do not face the sun nor the moon.'
ai.seo_question: What are the directional prohibitions for defecation in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi details the specific directional prohibitions for defecation, extending the reverence due to the Qiblah to include the sun and moon, which reflects the Shia scholarly view of cosmic respect in bodily functions. It establishes a comprehensive etiquette (adab) that balances physical purity with spiritual mindfulness, ensuring that the natural act is performed in a manner consistent with Islamic decorum.
